propositions: Repository-wide audit of documentation, comments, and prose against operator standards including punctuation rules, formal voice, filler elimination, and audience fit requires evidence-based remediation proposals organized by shard before any project changes.

Approved foundation work establishes documentation ownership policy, navigation improvements, and index validation; rejected work removes mechanical prose enforcement while retaining authoring guidance to prevent false positives.

Generated artifacts require generator-local descriptor protocols with explicit sources, outputs, update and verification paths rather than a centralized per-artifact registry to match practices in CPython, Kubernetes, Go, LLVM, and other maintained projects.

Documentation surfaces classify into external user guidance, internal durable records, and embedded developer comments with separate exploration owners applying precedence rules so mixed files assign to one reviewer and avoid overlapping responsibility.
